tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one published credit union by its slug.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get the number of published credit unions, places and categories, and when the data last changed.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories with their credit union counts.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List countries, regions and cities that have credit unions.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List where the credit union data comes from, with the license and refresh of each source.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search published credit unions by text, place and category.

q.description: Search text, with at least one letter or digit. Matches name, categories, attributes, description and place. Typos fall back to close matches.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case. A country the directory does not cover, as listed in /places, gives 400.

category.description: Category slug, from /categories. A parent slug also matches its children.

sort.description: `relevance` needs `q` and is the default with it. `name` is the default without `q`. `recent` is newest first.

cursor.description: `page.nextCursor` from the previous response. Opaque. Send the same filters and `limit`.
